articles.title: Across the Equator with an Old Map
articles.text: A research boat crossed the equator carrying an old map from an epoch when sailors drew coastlines by eye. Its elegant, almost esthetic curves were erroneous where erosion had removed a beach and a volcano had begun to erupt offshore. A local ethnic council sent an escort who explained that the essence of the island was not an eternal shape but a changing relationship with water. The team redrew the shore and added community names that earlier charts had ignored.
articles.translation: 一艘研究船穿越赤道，带着一张来自旧时代的地图；当时水手凭肉眼绘制海岸线。地图优美得近乎艺术的曲线在一些地方已经错误，因为侵蚀带走了海滩，近海火山也开始喷发。当地族群委员会派来一名向导，他解释说，岛屿的本质不是永恒形状，而是与水不断变化的关系。团队重新绘制海岸，并加入早期海图忽略的社区名称。

articles.title: Why Species Become Extinct
articles.text: An exceptional storm can expel animals from a small habitat, but extinction usually follows several pressures acting together. An exotic predator may take eggs, an exclusive road may divide feeding ground, and human activity can force a population into exile. A field expedition can exemplify the process by tracking survival and reproduction rather than relying on images that merely evoke sadness. No species is exempt from ecology, so conservation plans need careful execution across land, water, and local livelihoods.
articles.translation: 异常风暴会把动物赶出小型栖息地，但灭绝通常源于多种压力共同作用。外来捕食者会吃掉鸟蛋，专用道路会割裂觅食地，人类活动还会迫使种群离开家园。野外考察队可以通过追踪生存与繁殖来说明这个过程，而不是只依靠唤起悲伤的图像。任何物种都不能脱离生态规律，因此保护计划需要在土地、水域与当地生计之间认真执行。

articles.title: Exploration Budgets Need Public Value
articles.text: An expedition may expend public money to extract ice, rock, or biological samples that require rare expertise to interpret. Its budget should make each major expenditure explicit, including storage after grants expire and protection for an extinct species site. An exquisite exposition in a museum can share results, but beautiful displays cannot extinguish questions about local consent or damaged land. Funding is justified when data remain accessible, communities benefit, and researchers account for both discovery and repair.
articles.translation: 考察可能花费公共资金提取冰、岩石或生物样本，而解读这些样本需要稀缺专业知识。预算应明确列出每项主要支出，包括资助到期后的保存费用，以及对灭绝物种遗址的保护。博物馆里精美的展览可以分享成果，但漂亮陈列无法消除有关当地同意或土地受损的问题。当数据持续开放、社区受益，且研究人员同时对发现与修复负责时，资助才有正当性。
